links.outcome: Local diagnostic accuracy of qXR for TB versus radiologist and microbiological reference standard
links.effect: qXR showed near-human performance and met the WHO suggested accuracy profile; no numeric values reported in the abstract.
links.quote: qXR displays near-human performance satisfying the World Health Organization's suggested accuracy profile.

links.outcome: Radiologist-reported workflow disruption and workload burden with AI
links.effect: Radiologists reported high satisfaction, minimal workflow disruption, and limited increases in workload burden.
links.quote: Radiologists reported high satisfaction with using qXR based on minimal workflow disruptions, respect for their professional autonomy, and limited increases in workload burden despite poor algorithm explainability.

screen.reason: Empirical multidimensional evaluation of a commercial chest radiograph AI (qXR) assessing diagnostic accuracy, human factors usability/workflow, and task productivity among radiologists.
